application.name: @gftdcojp/spirit-in-physics
application.description: Jung's Word Association Test Embedding Model for quantifying the human spirit.

processes.name: Consent Process
processes.description: Handles user consent for research participation before the test begins.
steps: Display consent form and demographic questions.

processes.name: Jung's Voice Association Test
processes.description: Core process where the user performs the word association test via voice. Initially implemented using the browser's Web Speech API, but switched to Hume AI's API to resolve cross-browser compatibility issues.
steps: A stimulus word is presented visually and audibly from local files in `/public/audio`.
User clicks the 'Respond' button, which triggers the microphone access request.
Hume AI API captures and transcribes the user's voice in real-time.
Response and reaction time are recorded in the zustand store.
Process repeats for the configured number of words.

processes.name: Kawasaki Model Visualization
processes.description: Displays the 3D force graph representation of the Kawasaki Model.

components.name: PageClient
components.description: Main client-side component that orchestrates the overall page layout and flow.

components.name: ResearchParticipationConsent
components.description: UI component for capturing user consent and demographic information.

components.name: SpiritInPhysicsInteractive
components.description: Wrapper component that contains the main interactive voice assessment.

components.name: JungVoiceAssessment
components.description: Manages the setup for the voice test. It has been refactored to primarily pass props to JungVoiceTest.

components.name: JungVoiceTest
components.description: Handles the core logic of the voice test. Connects to Hume API for STT, plays audio cues, and uses the `kawasakiStore` for state management.

components.name: KawasakiModel
components.description: Renders the 3D visualization of the physics model.

components.name: kawasakiStore
components.description: Zustand store for global state management. Manages the entire lifecycle of the voice test, including status, words, responses, and final results.

steps.action: User clicks 'Start Test', triggering `startTest` action in zustand store.
State updates: `testStatus` to 'running', `currentWordIndex` to 0, stimulus words are shuffled and set.
Detects `currentWordIndex` change, plays audio for the stimulus word.
User clicks 'Respond', `startListening` is called, which requests microphone access and connects to Hume API.
Streams transcribed user's voice back to the client.
Receives transcription, calls `recordResponse` action in zustand store.
Adds response to `userResponses`, increments `currentWordIndex`. If the test is over, it calls `completeTest`.
(On complete) Calculates final results and saves them to `voiceAssessments` in persistent storage. `testStatus` is set to 'completed'.

troubleshooting.issue: Cross-browser voice recognition inconsistency (language-not-supported error in Edge).
troubleshooting.resolution: Replaced the browser's native Web Speech API with the Hume AI SDK for speech-to-text, ensuring consistent behavior across all modern browsers.

troubleshooting.issue: Hume API connection errors (`connect is not a function`, `send is not a function`).
troubleshooting.resolution: Investigated Hume AI's documentation and updated the code to use the latest API methods (`empathicVoice.chat.connect`, `sendAudioInput`) and types (`ChatSocket`). This also required adding a `secretKey` for authentication.

troubleshooting.issue: Microphone access errors (`Could not access microphone`).
troubleshooting.resolution: Changed the UX flow to initiate microphone access only after a direct user action (clicking a 'Respond' button), instead of automatically after audio playback. This complies with browser security policies.
Refactored key functions within `JungVoiceTest` to use `useCallback`, stabilizing their references and preventing unnecessary re-renders and dependency array changes.

troubleshooting.issue: Audio playback interruption errors (`play() request was interrupted`).
troubleshooting.resolution: Removed the shared `<audio>` element and refactored the logic to create a new, independent `Audio` object for each playback instance. This prevents conflicts between playback requests.

troubleshooting.issue: State management became complex within the `JungVoiceTest` component.
troubleshooting.resolution: Refactored the component to use a global `zustand` store (`kawasakiStore`) for all test-related state and logic. This simplified the component and centralized state management.

troubleshooting.issue: Persistent API errors due to library updates (`... is not a function`).
troubleshooting.resolution: When encountering recurring errors with an external library, a key troubleshooting step is to assume its API has changed. The process is to use web search to find the official documentation and up-to-date code samples. This provides a reliable source of truth to correct the implementation, as was done to resolve the Hume API connection and data sending methods.
